prompt: The repository is a brand-asset workspace that must ship three renders from one identity: a hero, an avatar, and a bottom-anchored footer card. `brief/brand.json` carries the palette, the identity descriptor and the thresholds; `brief/examples.json` records measurements the author observed from real renders; `generation/spec.json` is what you deliver. The harness renders each asset and measures it. Every prompt must contain the brief's identity descriptor verbatim, every asset must respect the palette and accent rules, the hero must keep its margins clear, the avatar must fill more of the frame while staying centred, and the footer card must put its mark in the lower half. Two variants per asset is the budget; the first conforming variant wins.

requirements: live image model reached over the network, with the token bucket and model list recorded in the brief
palette, identity descriptor and constraint thresholds disclosed in brief/brand.json
measurements from real renders of example specs shipped in brief/examples.json
generation spec replayed by the harness, one request per variant, at most two variants per target
per-image measurements: palette spread, background share, accent share, corner spread, border share, forbidden share

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The spec names the three required assets, pins distinct seeds within each asset, and states the brief identity descriptor.
The brief identity descriptor appears verbatim in every prompt that was rendered.
The harness obtained an image for the hero, the avatar and the footer card from the live service.
Every accepted render uses at most 12 colours to cover 95 percent of its pixels and carries the brief accent in at least 3 percent.
The hero render holds the margins and background share the brief requires.
The avatar render fills more of the frame than the hero while its subject stays within 0.20 of the frame centre on both axes.
The footer card places its subject centroid in the lower part of the frame with a clear border.

evidence: Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification
hierarchy boundary and specialist selection rationale
source/version boundary when facts can drift

requiredEvidence: recorded model identity and the exact prompt, seed and canvas per asset variant
the delivered generation spec with the identity descriptor
rendered images per asset and their measurements
evidence that the identity descriptor was reused verbatim in every rendered prompt
